verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation and startup-formation service, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Atlas offers any MCP-client or tool-plugin capability. The llms.txt and markdown-docs probes only show the docs are readable by AI tools, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
